message.content:
Sure thing! To craft a trip that feels just right for you, could you let me know a bit more about your plans?

| What would help me tailor the itinerary? | Example answers |
|----------------------------------------|-----------------|
| **Trip length** (days or weeks) | 5 days, 2 weeks, etc. |
| **Travel dates / season** | Summer 2025, late October, etc. |
| **Budget range** (per person) | €1,200–€2,500, etc. |
| **Interests** (art, food, history, nightlife, day‑trips, etc.) | Museums, culinary tours, day trips to Versailles, etc. |
| **Accommodation preference** | Boutique hotel, Airbnb, hostel, etc. |
| **Travel style** (solo, couple, family, group) | Solo, couple, family with kids, etc. |

Once I have those details, I can put together a personalized schedule, suggest flights, lodging, must‑see sights, dining spots, and even a rough budget breakdown. If you’re happy with a general “classic Paris” outline, just let me know and I’ll dive straight in!
